sources.snippet: What is MACE? MACE is a machine learning framework for predicting atomic interactions using higher-order equivariant message passing neural networks. The key innovation is leveraging E (3) equivariance—the mathematical property that predictions remain consistent under rotation and translation of atomic coordinates—combined with higher-order tensor features to achieve state-of-the-art ...
